title: Hruday window-kernel certificate for the centered Wilson correlation at the original cap
selection_reason: The Poisson kernel's absolute first moment diverges and forces the 1.2651e-6 floor at s=1, tau=10^-8. A C^2 window equal to e^{-sx} on the nonnegative spectral support has an L^1 transform with finite first moment, removing the cutoff and its tail. Combined with the AV1 linear state bound it targets the original cap and the unchanged 10^-6 point-error target.
model: Same actual chosen centered-box subsequential AQ state as AT4 at tau=+10^-8 (and -10^-8 as a control), selected triple (0,0,0), original xz Wilson, physical clock s=alpha*t_E/hbar, s=1, complete cover R={0,e_z} with seven incident stars, Haar product reference C_0(s)=e^{-3s}/4. The AV1 state bound D is the state premise.

parameters.window: g(x)=e^{-sx} for x>=0; g(x)=e^{sx}(1-2sx+2s^2x^2) for x<0
parameters.window_transform: ghat(theta)=4s^3/(pi(s-i theta)^3(s+i theta)), |ghat|=(4s^3/pi)(s^2+theta^2)^-2, ||ghat||_1=2, int|theta||ghat|=4s/pi, int theta^2|ghat|=2s^2
parameters.duhamel_slope: k=49|tau|/4 in G=H/alpha units from ||B_N||<=49|tau|/8 (seven stars)
parameters.state_bound: D from research/round32/advisor/av1-gate.json (tier ii if admitted, else tier i)
retained_insufficient_controls: optimized Poisson floor ~1.2651e-6 at L~4.08e6 with D->0

required: 1. Window lemma: for the actual centered vector chi=(pi(W)-omega(W))Omega with nonnegative GNS generator (AQ1) and finite spectral mass, prove C(s)=<chi,e^{-sG}chi>=int ghat(theta)c(theta)dtheta for the frozen C^2 window, justifying g in L^1, ghat in L^1, pointwise Fourier inversion and Fubini; prove the same identity for the free reference and C_0(s)=g(3)/4=e^{-3s}/4.

2. Prove ghat, |ghat|, ||ghat||_1=2, int|theta||ghat|=4s/pi and int theta^2|ghat|=2s^2 exactly (forward: direct transform of the two half-lines; reverse: a different route, e.g. differentiation under the transform or residues), with directed pi bounds in the checker.

3. Real-time comparison: |c(theta)-c_0(theta)|<=k|theta|+D_state+m^2 for all real theta with the admitted seven-star relative-unitary Duhamel argument (AT4 F11/F12), the AV1 state bound in the state term (the complex operator W alpha^0_theta(W) is not an effect; no D/2 refinement), and the first-order mean m^2 charged explicitly (m^2<=D^2, or the AW-type first-order value if admitted). Therefore |C(s)-C_0(s)|<=2(D+m^2)+49|tau|s/pi.

4. Evaluate at tau=+10^-8, s=1 the exact rational datum (free reference midpoint) and the complete point-error radius: state, mean-square, kernel-dynamics and arithmetic terms itemized; test the unchanged 10^-6 target; report both signs of tau; report the s at which the certificate crosses 10^-6 (about 6.1) and reject any [0,128] grid claim at the cap.

5. Retain the insufficient controls: the AT4 Poisson radius at L=10^4 and the optimized Poisson floor, both at unchanged parameters; show the Poisson kernel's divergent first moment and the window's finite one on the same footing.
6. Free-reference inclusion: state that e^{-3}/4 lies inside the interval; no interaction shift is resolved by this certificate (reference_unresolved sub-label).

7. Controls as fixtures: negative spectral atom misread by the window (nonnegativity essential), wrong clock, missing stars, vector versus scalar centering, changed model relabelled (tau=10^-14 or s=1/2 under the cap label rejected), tau scaling of the state term.

8. Reusable exact calculator API in the AT5 style (exact inputs only; floats rejected; fixed_design mode) restricted to the proved domain: zero selected triple, |tau|<=10^-8, s>0, physical scales positive, with D supplied from the admitted AV1 formula (tier ii or tier i as admitted).
9. Freeze protocol as in AV1; disclose the skeptic's kernel proposal and the advisor's symbolic verification as shared premises.
claim_exclusions: AQ uniqueness or a rate in N

preregistration.clock: s=alpha*t_E/hbar, theta=alpha*t/hbar; u=s/8 and exponent 24 forbidden in packets
claim_exclusions: free reference inside enclosure => no interaction claim
whole-sequence convergence or rate in N
relabelling a static shift as dynamical

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Window lemma and constants proved; complete radius at tau=+10^-8, s=1 at most 10^-6 with all terms itemized; both signs; insufficient controls retained.
acceptance.limited: Lemma proved but the radius exceeds 10^-6 because only the tier (i) state bound is admitted; report the dominating term.

stop: Investigation 2 of 10; sub-round 1 ends after its review and the assistants' tests.
